title: Core: AS2 with statement and namespace
description: Test compilation of AS2 with statement: with (obj) { trace(x); trace(y); }. Test that 'with' emits ActionWith (0x94) opcode. Test nested with statements. Also test AS2 namespace-like patterns (package in AS2 is just nested objects): _global.myPackage = {}; _global.myPackage.MyClass = function() {}. Verify ActionWith (0x94) is in bytecode for with statements.
